title: Nutty Croatian Stir-Fry
description: A flavorful and crunchy stir-fry dish with a mix of vegetables and nuts, inspired by Croatian cuisine.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced carrots and cook for 5 minutes, until they start to brown.
Add the chopped walnuts and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the Croatian paprika, stir-fry sauce, salt, and black pepper. Stir well to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened and the carrots are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or dill if desired.
